column1: # AdFree services table: one registrable domain per line, the company that
# owns it, separated by a TAB. # starts a comment; blank lines are ignored.
# Provenance and licence: authored for AdFree from the network names the app
# already curates in ThreatAnalyzer.kt plus the sections of the filter lists it
# subscribes to. A company owning a domain is a fact, and this file is ours to
# redistribute. Rows are kept only where the ownership is not in doubt; a
# domain missing here is shown by name, never by a guess.
# Scale-up path (not built): a build-time Wikidata P856 (official website)
# query, CC0, merged into this same file.
# Sorted by LC_ALL=C sort on the first field: the lookup binary searches.
